Permissions required by samples/access-packages-apps-sites.entra.json (mode: app, 9 resource(s))

Microsoft Graph application permissions
  Application.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/orders-portal
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogResources/9b670d0c-344e-5bd5-bfd1-671af6c67fb5
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/servicePrincipals/ref(/providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/orders-portal).appId
      (Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy would suffice for the applications this principal owns (1 resource(s)); provider)
  EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/accessPackages/Orders Approvers
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/accessPackages/Orders Approvers/assignmentPolicies/Requested by member users
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogResources/9b670d0c-344e-5bd5-bfd1-671af6c67fb5

      (provider)
  Organization.Read.All
      (every deployment)
      (preflight: GET /organization)
  Sites.FullControl.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogResources/a38d9404-750b-5e43-9d6b-7df630a44b5f
      (provider)

note: Application permissions are Microsoft Graph app roles granted (with admin consent) to the service principal EARM signs in with (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, or the managed identity). Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy replaces Application.ReadWrite.All for applications the service principal owns.
note: 1 resource(s) have a name that depends on another resource (for example a service principal named after reference(...).appId); their permissions are computed from the declaration and the references it contains.
note: Optional, not listed above: User.ReadBasic.All (or a broader user or directory read such as User.Read.All or Directory.Read.All) lets every online run read the tenant size right after the preflight (GET /users/$count) and pace Graph requests with the tenant's directory budget; without it the run goes on with the smallest tenant's budget (3,500 resource units per 10 s), which only makes a large deployment slower.
note: Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
